correctness.rationale: All nonempty subsets of the four patches satisfy the stated 15-state finite absorbing Markov backward system. Graph automorphisms yield 5 (C4) and 11 (paw) independent equations, whose exact solved rational functions were checked against every symbolic original equation and six independently solved full-state rational instances. The difference equals c^2 P9(c)/[12(5c+3)H7(c)], with positive denominator for every c>0. P9 has exactly one coefficient sign change, P9(0)<0, and a positive leading term, proving one and only one positive switch by Descartes and continuity. Exact weak/strong rate limits and strict Perron comparison were also verified. The finite checks supplement rather than replace this complete sign proof.

value.rationale: A path of four patches is the smallest connected path admitting two nonisomorphic one-extra-corridor choices; costs and individual colonization rates are matched. Their exact persistence-time ranking changes at one explicitly characterized rate even as the spectral-radius ranking stays fixed. This is a complete finite topology-selection classification for an ecologically motivated first-passage objective, not an arbitrary numerical table entry, and clarifies when connectivity proxies misrank a small stochastic metapopulation. It has no extrapolated policy or larger-graph claim.
